hook: Turned 300+ SQL views into a knowledge graph you can question, simulate and explain.

problem.statementExec: The planning logic — margins, freight, crew costs, depreciation — lives in hundreds of interdependent SQL views. Answering one innocent question, 'where does this number come from?', takes an engineer days.
problem.statementTech: Large financial planning systems accumulate hundreds of interdependent database views encoding business logic. Two bottlenecks dominate: lineage questions require manually parsing raw SQL for days, and what-if modelling of parameter changes (a freight-rate shift, a volume drop) ripples through hundreds of intermediate calculations that no one can trace safely.
painPoints: Days of engineering time to trace a single number's lineage
What-if modelling confined to fragile, disconnected spreadsheets
No safe way to test how one change ripples to the bottom line
marginNotes: 300+ views parsed via AST into a graph
DAG propagation recomputes every dependent node
AI tools exposed read-only over the graph

approach.summaryExec: We turned the whole view estate into a living dependency graph, then put two things on top: a simulator that shows how any parameter change cascades to profit, and a conversational analyst that answers lineage questions in plain English.

stages.label: Parse
stages.captionExec: A scheduled job reads every view and works out what depends on what.
stages.captionTech: SQL AST parsing extracts column-level dependencies — CTEs, subqueries, window functions — into structured dependency maps.

stages.label: Graph
stages.captionExec: All of it becomes one map: views, inputs, metrics, and how they feed each other.
stages.captionTech: A property graph stores View, Calculation, Input, Scenario and Metric nodes with explicit FEEDS / DEPENDS_ON / CALCULATES edges, auto-synced from live definitions.

stages.label: Simulate
stages.captionExec: Move a slider — a rate, a volume — and watch the effect cascade to net profit in real time.
stages.captionTech: Graph-traversal propagation recomputes dependent node values down the DAG when inputs change; scenarios run side by side with delta tracking.

stages.label: Explain
stages.captionExec: Ask why profit moved and the assistant walks the graph to show the exact path.
stages.captionTech: An MCP-enabled conversational agent answers via grounded tool calls — schema discovery, relationship lookups, Cypher execution — in read-only mode.

stages.label: Serve
stages.captionExec: Analysts get a self-service workspace: chat, scenario controls and waterfall charts. Zero SQL.
stages.captionTech: Analyst dashboard with conversational chat, variable sliders, scenario selectors and dynamic waterfall visualisations of revenue and profit deltas.

engine.evaluation: Lineage answers were validated against hand-traced queries across representative views; simulation deltas were reconciled against manual recalculations for sample scenarios. The graph auto-syncs on a schedule, so documentation can never drift from the live database.

value.before: Engineers reading raw SQL for days to answer simple questions; analysts guessing at variances; what-if modelling that meant rebuilding fragile spreadsheets by hand.
value.after: A living map of the entire planning logic: lineage in seconds from a chat box, scenarios compared side by side, and every variance explained down the exact graph path that caused it.

metrics.label: views mapped into one dependency graph
